text: Android: the add-item dialog closes at once on the first + after a save

Review for the same bug class (one-shot state in a view model that outlives its dialog or screen): the list and registry undo snackbars re-appeared after leaving and coming back; fixed. Navigation effects (login, leave, duplicate, account gone, redeem, joined list, share intents) clear their state or pop their screen: fine. The web keeps such state in components that unmount: fine.
